author: davidsnam-intel
title: Build (C++20) job fails - sccache cannot start because Azure Blob connection string URI is malformed
signature: sccache server startup failed cache storage failed to read unexpected permanent at read azbloberror code invaliduri message the requested uri does not represent any resource on the server|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails at the trivial C-compiler-check test compile because sccache's wrapped compiler invocation errors with 'sccache: error: Server startup failed: cache storage failed to read: Unexpected (permanent) at read => AzblobError { code: "InvalidUri" ... }'

key_errors:
-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
CMake will not be able to correctly generate this project.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  CMakeLists.txt:42 (project)
root_cause: The sccache server fails to start because the Azure Blob Storage connection/container URI it builds contains a double slash ('ghasccacheblobs.blob.core.windows.net//sccache/...'), which Azure's Blob API rejects with a 400 InvalidUri error. This happens during CMake's trivial C-compiler-check test compile, before any PR-specific compilation occurs, so it is unrelated to the PR's actual source changes (which only touch GPU kv_cache/primitive_inst code and a unit test). This is the same recurring CI infrastructure/configuration misconfiguration already recorded 4 times as pattern 08b993dbdc18ccac, now recurring a 5th time, again in the C++20 (Ubuntu 22.04) Build job.
reproduction_steps: N/A - CI-infrastructure configuration issue in the sccache Azure Blob cache backend setup (SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING / key-prefix construction), not reproducible by rebuilding locally without the same Azure cache configuration.
recommended_actions: Fix the sccache Azure Blob Storage configuration so the computed blob URI never contains a doubled '/' (sanitize trailing slashes when concatenating the storage account URL with SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX in the CI environment/action that sets these variables).
Add a pre-flight check or SCCACHE_IGNORE_SERVER_IO_ERROR-based fallback to no-cache compilation when the sccache server fails to start, instead of failing the whole CMake configure step.

This is the 5th occurrence of the same signature across multiple jobs/OS variants - escalate to the team owning the sccache/Azure cache CI infrastructure for a permanent fix rather than relying on reruns.
prevention_strategies: Validate the SCCACHE_AZURE_* environment variables (connection string, key prefix) at CI setup time to catch a malformed/double-slash URI before it reaches sccache; add a guard or sanitation step in the reusable CI action that assembles the Azure blob path.
historical_context: This exact signature (sccache Azure InvalidUri on blob URI with a doubled slash) was first recorded 2026-11-06T11:53:20Z and has now been seen 5 times total across the GenAI job and the C++20 Build job (Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 variants). The root cause (CI sccache/Azure cache configuration) is identical across jobs even though the job name/OS differs.
